title: Agent Task Contract — execution report
description: The 12 required fields of _evidence/report.json (SPEC.md §6). Additional properties are allowed: executors may add their own evidence fields, but these 12 must be present.

deliverables.description: Files produced by this task, as declared in the task brief.

test_cmd.description: The exact acceptance command that was run.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the acceptance command. 0 means passed.

passed.description: Number of passing checks reported by the executor's own suite.

failed.description: Number of failing checks. Must be 0 when status is 'passed'.

budget_used_min.description: Wall-clock minutes consumed, measured from the dispatch timestamp in the task brief.

selfcheck_runs.description: Self-check runs counted per class. The same class reaching 3 means failed_selfcheck_limit.

long_run_used.description: Long-running commands actually executed, with measured seconds.

tests_modified.description: True if the executor changed its own tests. A diff and rationale must then be attached; otherwise the check does not count as passed.

deliverable_check.description: Self-reported presence check for each declared deliverable. Independently re-checked by the coordinator.

status.description: Final status. 'failed_selfcheck_limit' is reserved for exceeding the per-class self-check limit.

notes.description: Free-form notes: what was done, what failed, what was left over. Do not rely on assistantText; this field is the durable record.
